roles.blurb: Sensor-based prototypes, microcontrollers and circuit simulation.
roles.headline: Electronics engineer building sensor-based embedded and IoT prototypes.
roles.summary: Registered Electronics Engineer with a Master of Science in Engineering (Electronics and Telecommunication). I integrate sensors, microcontrollers and displays into working prototypes, and mentor student teams through design, build and testing.
why: PRC-registered Electronics Engineer, with a BS in Electronics Engineering and Computer Science.
Smart Helmet: coach and named inventor of a wearable safety prototype that won the Silver Prize at SIIF 2024 and the SIBOL First Prize at NICE 2024.
HYDRA: a kiosk that integrates a MAX30102 pulse oximeter and cameras with machine-learning analysis.

projects.why: Raspberry Pi with MQ-2 gas, accelerometer, GPS and GSM modules, plus machine-learning risk analysis.
Eye camera, urine-strip camera, MAX30102 sensor and water dispenser in one kiosk.

roles.blurb: Automated prototypes, robot simulation and winning student robotics teams.
roles.headline: Engineer building automated prototypes and coaching winning robotics teams.
roles.summary: I develop microcontroller- and computer-controlled prototypes and work with robot simulators. I have trained in PLCs, SCADA and industrial robots, and I have coached student teams to wins in robotics and intelligent-machine contests.
why: Winning Coach in Robotics and Intelligent Machine under the Department of Education.
HYDRA: an automated scan, analyse and dispense sequence that coordinates cameras, a pulse sensor and a pump.
Training in industrial automation: PLC, SCADA and industrial robots.

projects.why: A timed operating sequence across sensors, machine-learning analysis and a dispenser.
Continuous monitoring and GSM emergency-alert behaviour in a Raspberry Pi wearable.

roles.blurb: Computer vision, classification and prediction with web interfaces.
roles.headline: Applied AI and machine learning engineer focused on computer vision.
roles.summary: I build image-analysis and prediction systems end to end: segmentation, detection, classification, and web interfaces that return results with visual explanations.
why: HYDRA: U-Net segmentation, YOLOv11 strip detection and an SVM classifier combined with sensor readings.
VISION: a CNN-based classifier whose predictions come with a probability chart and a Grad-CAM overlay.
RETINA: OpenCV feature extraction and a cross-validated Random Forest, implemented in Python.

projects.why: Multimodal machine learning: segmentation, object detection, classification and sensor data.
End-to-end Python pipeline with feature extraction, cross-validation and a Flask interface.
CNN image classification with probability output and Grad-CAM heatmaps.
Gradient-boosted aftershock forecasting on historical earthquake data.

roles.blurb: Feature engineering, statistics and forecasting from real measurements.
roles.headline: Data-driven engineer: feature engineering, statistics and forecasting.
roles.summary: I turn measurements into defined quantities, test them statistically and model them: fractal features from images, correlation analysis, forecasting from historical data, and SQL-backed analysis history.
why: RETINA: engineered features, Pearson and Spearman correlations with p-values and r², z-score standardisation, and ROC / Youden's J cutoffs, all in Python.
HYSEIS: Omori–Utsu and Gutenberg–Richter models with XGBoost on historical earthquake data.
More than ten years of teaching engineering mathematics, which supports explaining models clearly.

projects.why: Feature engineering, statistical tests, cross-validated classification and a SQLite analysis history.
Forecasting aftershocks from historical data, shown on an interactive map.
Features from images combined with sensor readings in one classifier.
Statistical dashboards of learners by grade level and gender.

roles.blurb: Licensed teacher of mathematics, physics and ICT who coaches student research and robotics.
roles.headline: Licensed mathematics and STEM teacher who connects classroom learning to engineering practice.
roles.summary: I teach General Mathematics, Calculus, Statistics and Probability, General Physics and Computer Systems Servicing to Senior High School students, using practical examples, collaborative activities and technology. I also coach student teams in research, robotics and innovation.
why: Licensed Professional Teacher and Certified 6-12 Secondary Teacher with endorsement in Mathematics.

Teaching since 2017 at Lanna National High School: General Mathematics, Calculus, Statistics and Probability, General Physics and Computer Systems Servicing. Earlier, instructor in engineering and mathematics at Isabela State University.
MS Teaching (Mathematics), with an engineering background in Electronics and Computer Science, and a PhD in Educational Management in progress (candidate).

Winning Coach in Robotics and Intelligent Machine, and in Mathematics and Computational Science, under the Department of Education; coach of National Science and Technology Fair finalist teams in 2025 and 2026.

projects.why: Coached student inventors to the Silver Prize at SIIF 2024 and the SIBOL First Prize at NICE 2024.
Web system that automates student records, attendance and grading for a school.
